system.description:
Skill: Survival

Exploit Type: Combat Exploit

Requirements: Wolves Legacy

You break through your enemy’s guard, scoring a brutal strike. When you deal Lethal Attack damage, you may choose to forgo 1 Lethal Attack damage dice. If this exploit is used as part of your Retaliate ability, you instead forgo no Lethal Attack damage dice

The damaged creature cannot cast jutsu that would boost their AC or provide them bonus DR (damage reduction) until the end of your next turn.

activities.label: Lethal Attack (forgo 1)
activities.text: Once per turn, on a hit with advantage or with an ally within 5 feet of the target.

activities.label: Lethal Attack (forgo 1): Attack action or weapon
activities.text: An attack of the Attack action or a weapon attack: half the dice, rounded up (minimum 1).

activities.label: Posture Break
activities.text: Wolves Legacy. Until the end of your next turn it can't cast jutsu that raise its AC or give it DR. With Retaliate: no dice forgone (use the plain Lethal Attack button).
